column1: # The minimal profile (../profile-minimal.tsv) cut to the rehearsal's four
# containers (pc00 + 3 workers, 2 CPUs each): the same experiments in the
# same order, N to what fits, one repeat after the warm-up. headless-test.sh
# passes it as LAB_PROFILE. Sizes are the day's own calibration at a 10 s
# target (LAB_CAL_STRONG_S), except where --rehearsal picks the smoke sizes:
# e4 (caps 2/1/1 instead of 8/4/2/1), e5 (numpy and joblib, not torch) and e8
# (one epoch). e1's N=4 is one more than Ray and Dask have workers for: those
# runs must be recorded as failed while the experiment goes on.
